{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_minutes",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "issue_theme",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Directly realizes the 'issue themes' dimension of the query. Interpretable, well-separated semantic categories that can be grouped and compared against resolution time. Some tail categories are small but the head is well-populated."
    },
    {
      "name": "ticket_class",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Coarser, well-separated typology (bug, feature_request, outage, etc.) with good cell sizes. Meaningful segmentation likely to show strong resolution-time differences; distinct enough from issue_theme to add value."
    },
    {
      "name": "operational_impact",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable severity/impact scale (minor_friction to compliance_deadline) with populated categories. Highly plausible associate of resolution time and easy to group on."
    },
    {
      "name": "scope_of_impact",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear breadth categories (single_user to cross_tenant) with adequate cell sizes for comparison, though 'not_stated' is large. Interpretable external segmentation associated with resolution effort."
    },
    {
      "name": "root_cause_class",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable causal categories usable for segmentation. 'not_identified' is large but remaining categories are well-separated and plausibly associated with resolution time."
    },
    {
      "name": "requires_escalation",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean binary with balanced-enough cells (53 vs 197). Escalation is a strongly interpretable associate of longer resolution times; ideal for a two-group comparison."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The set consists entirely of external, interpretable categorical variables with well-separated categories and generally adequate cell sizes, directly supporting grouped comparison against resolution_minutes. It covers the query's 'issue theme' dimension (issue_theme, ticket_class) and adds interpretable severity/scope/cause/escalation segmentations. None merely restate the focus or produce opaque scores. Minor weaknesses: some tail categories are sparse and a few columns carry large 'not_stated'/'not_identified' buckets, slightly limiting comparison quality; issue_theme and ticket_class overlap somewhat. Overall a strong EDA augmentation."
}
